Apache POI 5.5.1, adapted for Android using centic9/poi-on-android
https://github.com/centic9/poi-on-android/tree/a29c7a4cdd94175c2be43678c82afc818b60ff3f

Android adapter copyright 2015-2024 Dominik Stadler.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; see ../Apache-2.0.txt.

Doppel builds the upstream poishadow module and uses its Java sources unchanged.
Build-only changes: retain commons-codec and commons-lang3 omitted by the demo;
make archive timestamps/order reproducible; export dependency versions, hashes,
and upstream notices. ProGuard consumer rules are adapted from the upstream
sample, omitting app-wide optimization settings and preserving parser factories.

Original LICENSE/NOTICE files from the bundled Maven artifacts are reproduced
verbatim beside this file with coordinate-prefixed names. Apache POI, XMLBeans,
Commons libraries and the relocated StAX API remain under their original licenses.
The excluded curvesapi dependency is not bundled in this jar.

StAX API 1.0.1 (stax:stax-api)
The published Maven POM declares the Apache Software License, Version 2.0.
Its binary distribution contains no separate LICENSE/NOTICE file.
See ../Apache-2.0.txt.
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/stax/stax-api/1.0.1/stax-api-1.0.1.pom
